name: Pelican
description: The payload carrier. Moves large datasets and media safely through pipelines, keeping transfers visible and organized.
visualNotes: A Gulf Coast brown pelican with a clean field-utility harness and a reinforced data pouch; friendly, capable, and unmistakably coastal.
signatureAction: A pouch-load swoop that gathers a payload and delivers it to the right destination.
